About this event

A moving drama about a middle-class English family learning to cope with war, told in a series of dramatic vignettes.

Every movie starts with a story at the North Bend Theatre. Just prior to each of the Love & War movies, our resident film experts, Kevin & Beth, will share the amazing stories behind these great films.
